book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.ar: باسبارتو لف بالقرية، وما لقى حصان.
sentences.en: Passepartout went round the village, and found no horse.
But he found an elephant.
A big elephant, belonging to an Indian who was training it for war.
Fogg said: I will hire it.
The Indian said: no.
Fogg said: ten pounds an hour.
The Indian said: no.
Fogg said: I will buy it.
A thousand pounds.
The Indian said: no.
And Passepartout felt he would faint.
Fogg said: twelve hundred.

sentences.ar: لا. ألف وخمسمية. لا. ألف وتمانمية.
sentences.en: No. Fifteen hundred. No. Eighteen hundred.
Passepartout said: sir!
This elephant will eat all the money!
Fogg said: two thousand.
And the Indian said: yes.
And the elephant's name was Kiouni, and he was Fogg's.

sentences.ar: ولقوا دليل، شاب هندي، بيعرف الغابة.
sentences.en: And they found a guide, a young Indian, who knew the forest.

sentences.ar: وركبوا: فوغ والسير فرانسيس بسلة على الجنبين.
sentences.en: And they mounted: Fogg and Sir Francis in baskets on the sides.
And Passepartout on the back.
And the elephant walked through the forest.

sentences.ar: يوم كامل، والشجر فوقهم، والقرود بتصرخ.
sentences.en: A whole day, the trees above them, the monkeys screeching.

sentences.ar: وباسبارتو بيتنطط على ظهر الفيل زي الكرة.
sentences.en: And Passepartout bounced on the elephant's back like a ball.
And at night, they slept in an abandoned hut.

sentences.ar: وتاني يوم، بعد الظهر، الدليل وقف الفيل فجأة.
sentences.en: And the next day, in the afternoon, the guide stopped the elephant suddenly.
And said: be silent.
And from afar, came a sound.
Drums, chanting, many people.

sentences.ar: الدليل أخد الفيل ورا الشجر، واستخبوا.
sentences.en: The guide took the elephant behind the trees, and they hid.
And a procession passed.

sentences.ar: كهنة، وتمثال إلهة بأربع إيدين، وناس بيرقصوا.
sentences.en: Priests, a statue of a goddess with four arms, people dancing.

sentences.ar: وبعدهم، مرا شابة، ماشية، وحواليها حرس.
sentences.en: And after them, a young woman, walking, with guards around her.

sentences.ar: حلوة كتير، ووجهها أبيض، وعينها مش شايفة.
sentences.en: Very beautiful, her face pale, her eyes seeing nothing.

sentences.ar: وبعدها، رجال حاملين رجل ميت، كبير بالعمر، لابس تياب أمير.
sentences.en: And after her, men carrying a dead man, old, in a prince's clothes.
Sir Francis whispered: a suttee.
Fogg said: what does that mean?

sentences.ar: قال السير فرانسيس: بكرا الصبح، بيحرقوا الميت.
sentences.en: Sir Francis said: tomorrow morning, they burn the dead man.
And the woman with him.
Alive.
